protocol.codec: exact reduced ordered BDD representation v1.0
protocol.region_rule: first and last disjoint equal regions; skip when file_bytes < 2*size; no padding
protocol.selection: per file/size smallest decision-diagram+zstd9 (G) on dev, frozen before validation
reductions: eliminate nodes whose low and high children are identical
protocol.serialization: level-wise records; mode 0 absolute varints, mode 1 delta varints; roots, terminals, order, levels and counts charged

gate.baseline: min(A,B,C,D,E,E_zstd9) per region, summed per file
